data.template_description: Sharp and app-like: a wide display face, a tilting wallet card and a dock of service icons that magnify.
Dark and gilded: a light serif headline, a rail of icons lit by a travelling pulse, and a card with a turning gold edge.
Editorial and warm: a serif headline, an arched receipt, a spinning stamp and ticket-style plans.
Bright and glassy: frosted cards over a colour wash, a fan of service passes and glossy icon bubbles that drift.
Loud and itemised: poster type, a receipt that prints itself, a rubber stamp, keycap services and a price ticker.
Playful and chunky: service icons orbit a live wallet, with sticker labels and hard-shadow cards.
